fixtures.description: Minimal valid forge.workspace.json index with one policy-source resource.
Valid index exercising every supported role exactly once.
Rejected because the resource path is absolute (leading slash).
Rejected because a path segment is the parent-directory traversal '..'.
Rejected because the path contains a backslash (Windows separator).
Rejected because the path carries a Windows drive prefix 'C:'.
Rejected because schema_version is 'forge.workspace/2' instead of the const 'forge.workspace/1'.
Rejected because the role 'policy-artifact' is outside the closed role enum.
Rejected because of the unknown property 'approval_state'; the index is closed and must not admit approval state.
Minimal valid unlock request for unlockSession.
Rejected because the passphrase is shorter than the 15-character minimum for unlockSession.
Valid 200 getSession body: writable browser session with API major and contract version discovery.
Valid 200 unlockSession body returning the one-time memory-only browser capability and session metadata.
Valid 200 getProjectSummary body: needs-attention health, reconciled resource and review counts, next human action.
Valid registerResource body referencing an existing root-contained Markdown policy.
Rejected because the upload target_path is absolute; uploads must target a confirmed root-contained path.
Valid listResources page envelope: one item, null next_cursor (last page), total_matching denominator.
Valid preparePolicyConversion body for an OSCAL Catalog output.
Valid getConversion 200 body: derived product summary, validation diagnostics, and the bound EffectPreview with create status and one-time receipt.
Valid getEffectPreview 200 body: overwrite target, base/target hashes, input hashes, warning diagnostic, escaped diff, and receipt with expiry.
Valid commitEffectPreview body: one-time receipt token, observed version, and literal confirmation intent.
Valid getApplicabilityReport 200 body: current input fingerprints, all six classification counts, and the 263-control denominator.
Valid getReviewQueueCounts 200 body whose by_reason counts sum to total_open (12).
Valid listReviewQueueItems page envelope: two stable reason-code items, non-null next_cursor, total_matching denominator.
Valid 409 error envelope exercising the stable code 'version-conflict' with the current resource_version; documents AC-21.
Valid 403 error envelope exercising the stable code 'read-only-session' returned by every mutation operation in a read-only session.
Valid 410 error envelope exercising the stable code 'receipt-expired' with a retryable safe recovery message.
Valid 422 error envelope exercising the stable code 'validation-failed' with a safe field pointer and no source excerpt.
Valid generic 401 error envelope exercising the stable code 'unauthorized' with no project-state or credential disclosure.
Valid generic unlock failure envelope exercising the stable code 'unlock-failed'; indistinguishable for any wrong passphrase.
Valid succeeded commit operation lifecycle: typed CommitResult with write_committed true and the committed hash (AC-22 response-loss recovery).
Valid running applicability-analysis operation with bounded progress facts and cancellation not yet requested.
Valid failed conversion operation carrying a safe terminal error and stating that no output was written.
Valid prepareReportExport body: applicability-gap report, strict-default redaction profile, static HTML format.
